reviews.name: Sean DE PALMA
reviews.text: Frankie was great with my teenage daughter and her hair came out wonderfully! Clean and trendy salon that is perfectly located in Miami Beach.

reviews.name: Becky Budhoo
reviews.text: Frank recently cut my hair, and it looked like I stepped out of a Vogue magazine photoshoot. The layers were cut to perfection, and he even gave me tips on how to care for my kind of naturally curly hair. His attention to detail is superb, and his personality is awesome. He knew exactly how to give me the layers I wanted. I highly recommend that you visit Frank for all of your hair needs. You won't regret it.

reviews.name: Tessa Trlaja
reviews.text: Frank is an amazing hair stylist and color expert. He did a kaps filler smoothing treatment and ash blonde high lights. He is very knowledgeable! Perfect results. Never had such smooth hair! Highly recommend him to everybody. Go see Frank at head to toes!!!

reviews.name: Edwin Meza
reviews.text: By far, the best haircut I have ever had! I am really happy with the service and professionalism from this salon. Thank you guys!

reviews.name: Stephanie Simao
reviews.text: If you've been disheartened with the hair care industry, look no further! This is the salon I have been looking for here in Miami! Since my arrival here to South Florida, I had been so disappointed with the level of professionalism, knowledge and customer service within the beauty industry. Finally after 7 years, I found Frankie at Head to Toe Salon! He's so adorable, so kind, so professional and so smart when it comes to coloring and styling of hair!
reviews.note: Original review continues past this point on Birdeye but is cut off mid-sentence behind a 'read more' control; trimmed here at the last complete sentence, verbatim up to that point, nothing added.
